value.credibility_line: Guidance repeats, but provided results end Mar 2024, so FY26-FY27 promises remain too early to judge.

promises.promise: FY26 AUM growth around 18% versus 17-18% range later stated.
FY26 NPM/NIM growth 18% YoY, with FY26 NIM 8.45% and 29 bps expansion.
FY26 opex-to-asset below 3%, reiterated in FY27.
FY26 borrowings around Rs 67.05 billion at competitive cost.
FY27 disbursement growth at least 20%, cost of borrowing expected to rise.

guidance_now: Too early to judge credibility; most FY26 guidance has no provided post-call results.
bull: Management has repeated AUM growth targets, giving a clear benchmark for later review.
FY26 capital, credit-cost and opex guidance are specific, improving future checkability.
bear: FY26 AUM guidance cannot be checked yet; actuals stop at Mar 2024, so delivery is too_early.
FY27 promises are also ahead of provided results, so near-term execution remains untested.
questions: FY26 revenue growth, net profit, spread and credit cost are not in the provided results.
